answer: Each agent must post a bond on the shared ledge of a multi-unit auction ledger, locking capital in a vault whose balance is checked at every identity vertex during epoch settlement. Sybil identities cannot reuse the same bonded vault, so duplicate registrations collapse into one collateralized vertex and lose auction priority under the anti-collusion rule. Adversaries forging identities face an immediate O(k * S) capital forfeiture.
